FROM wcs_log_bak
FROM wcs_log
AND dvc_no = #{dvcNo} AND cur_pos = #{chute}
AND create_date >= CAST(#{params.beginTime} AS DATE)
AND create_date < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(#{params.endTime} AS DATE))
AND create_date >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND create_date < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
AND (work_name = 'sd_report_confirm')
